lines.en: You know, once you're inside, you don't have to knock anymore.
Doing what? We're not doing anything.
We're just sitting around talking. Quietly.
I can hear you through the ceiling.
We'll try to keep it down.
It's freezing out here. Would you come back inside?
You wanted me to take them down,
Mr. Heckles, could you help me, please?
See, this is just the kind of thing I was talking about.
And it's just the kind of thing I was talking about.
